title: Yun Zhi
summary: Xiao Yan flies out of the shrine with the Heavenly Flame, but Gu He's group catches up and demands it. Yao Lao takes over, and Ms. Yun intercepts him while Gu He, Yan Shi and Feng Li head for the desert edge. Meanwhile the Snakemen leaders gather, with cards for Yan Ci, Nan She, Hei Du, Kui Xing and King Hua She, and plan to trap the Dou Huang with the Five Snake Poison Breaking Seal. Ms. Yun catches Xiao Yan, then lets him go when she sees who he is. He recognises her as Yun Zhi, and she knows him as Yao Yan. She offers to recommend him to the Misty Cloud Sect, and he refuses angrily. She tries to stop him from swallowing the flame, and he leaves her, promising to repay her someday.

Ms. Yun holds off the Snakemen and sends Gu He after the flame.

She asks for the flame so he won't risk his life; he leaves, promising to repay her.
